description: Ten mapped D094 landscape candidates pinned to native versions and checksums for unapproved review.
review_notice: Unapproved landscape candidates for comparison only. Fresh independent v008 reviewers pass S001-S005 and S007-S010. S006 v011 remained uncertain because the viewer-left deity toe tips overlapped; one authorized localized edit produced selected v012 with five visibly separated toes and the sacred thread retained. Producer review records disclosed Bhattathiri skin patch medians, including R-B 130 maximum 132, above the plan target of about 120; fresh independent full review is pending. Prior disclosed deviations for S003 v009, S008 v007, and S009 v005 remain recorded. No further generation is authorized. Producer reviews are separate from independent review and do not imply artwork approval. Captions 1–10 map faithfully to stanzas 1–10; photos 011–014 remain unmapped extras. Portrait production remains paused.
visual_review_status: producer-reviewed; fresh independent full exact-checksum review pending for all ten current selected landscape candidates

rows.scene: A single all-pervading presence and varied flames evoke the chapter’s first teaching.
rows.candidate_status: Three groups of distinct logs carry small, medium and large flames against the cosmic spiral; no people or text appear. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: The teaching fire clears a tangled forest and settles into quiet knowledge.
rows.candidate_status: Two crossed logs meet beneath one controlled flame, separate from the burning branch tangle and calm clearing. No people or readable text appear. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri turns from temporary remedies toward Bhagwan’s refuge.
rows.candidate_status: Bhattathiri turns toward Bhagwan with folded hands; the image shows him kneeling with folded lower legs rather than seated as specified. One exposed foot shows five toes; the other is tucked; Bhagwan’s visible open blessing hand shows five digits and both visible feet show five toes. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: warm-brown skin target is R-B below 120. Independent reviewer’s skin-only 11x11 patches, using crop-origin coordinates, measured cheek origin (350,310) RGB (184,104,58) R-B 126 and torso origin (280,480) RGB (187,111,66) R-B 121. My exact-check remeasurement at the same origins matched. Additional skin-only origins: cheek (360,320) RGB (180,101,54) R-B 126; upper arm/torso (250,490) RGB (155,80,42) R-B 113. These two reviewer patches exceed target; no regeneration because repair rounds are exhausted. Producer reinspection needs-fix; independent exact-checksum re-review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Even the highest celestial realm is unsettled; the poet seeks refuge and release.
rows.candidate_status: Bhattathiri’s head, eyes and folded prayer hands face Bhagwan at right; both legs and feet are naturally tucked beneath the dhoti and not visible. Brahma has four distinct heads and four attached arms; Bhagwan’s visible open hands each show thumb plus four fingers. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: sampled 11x11 cheek patch RGB medians (194,111,71), (186,107,72), (180,97,60) have R-B 123/114/120; torso patch RGB medians (210,124,82), (201,124,91), (200,115,75) have R-B 128/110/125. The brown-skin target is under about 120; sampled face/torso patch medians are 120/125. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: One tree holds both dream and waking; attachment tastes fruit while freedom rests.
rows.candidate_status: Sleeper face skin-only patch median R-B 108; both visible hands show thumb plus four fingers and both feet show five toes. The sleeper lies beneath one branching tree; no duplicated person or text appears. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri offers his mind in devotion and receives the guru’s word.
rows.candidate_status: Bhattathiri's required off-white sacred thread remains visible from left shoulder to right waist. The viewer-left deity foot now shows five clearly separated toes; the other visible deity foot shows five. Bhattathiri's exposed foot shows five; the other is tucked. His namaste has five visible fingertip ends with thumbs overlapped. Guruvayurappan's two open hands each show thumb plus four fingers. Bhattathiri 11x11 skin-only medians: cheek origin (390,300) RGB (161,84,47) R-B 114; torso (360,420) (195,107,65) R-B 130; arm (390,470) (141,75,40) R-B 101. Additional skin windows at (385,350) R-B 124, (320,460) 129, (420,480) 129, (435,500) 121, (460,500) 132, and (390,520) 130. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: several warm-brown skin patches exceed the plan's R-B target of about 120; these are recorded, not concealed. Guruvayurappan face/torso B-R samples are 41/59. One of each figure; no readable text or rays/beams. Producer review pass with disclosed skin deviation; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: An unmarked scripture and a healthy unmilked cow recall labor without devotion.
rows.candidate_status: Open, completely blank palm-leaf manuscript shows a clear two-leaf spread beside a healthy cow; the enlarged lower-body view shows four attached legs ending in four hooves. The empty bowl and silent flower remain. No letters, symbols, people or deity. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri worships Bhagwan and follows the footprints of the beloved devotees.
rows.candidate_status: DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Bhattathiri’s warm-brown skin target is R-B below about 120. Independent reviewer’s skin-only 11x11 patch medians: face (380,345) RGB (197,115,63), R-B 134; torso (300,500) RGB (166,90,45), R-B 121; arm (475,540) RGB (201,118,67), R-B 134. Both open hands show thumb plus four fingers; one visible bare foot has five toes and the other is tucked; Bhagwan’s visible hands and feet show the expected digits/toes. Full-bleed scene has one Bhattathiri and one Bhagwan with the required footprints and no frame. Producer reinspection pass with disclosed skin deviation; independent exact-checksum re-review pending; no artwork approval.

Independent reviewer values, reproduced exactly: cheek origin (420,170) RGB (172,88,49), R-B 123; chest (390,260) RGB (178,90,52), R-B 126; forearm (470,360) RGB (180,94,56), R-B 124. rows.scene: The gopikas’ loving circle around Krishna expresses the devotion he honors.
